--- Page 1 (Beckerman_43a) --- Dear Mom and Papa: Received another letter from you today which I enjoyed as much as all the rest. They are very easy to read. I also received a letter from Ruth—her letters are written beautifully. I think she will be home before this letter so I am sending her a letter in this envelope which I wish you would give to her as soon as you can. Everything here is fine. Yesterday, the Japs arrived in Manila. I did not get a chance to see them. You asked about the Padd. I get along very nicely out it. Of course it's a little [illegible] from what you [illegible] --- Page 2 (Beckerman_43b) --- anyway, we never go hungry. Plenty of canned meat, vegetables, and fruit - all canned. Plenty of masher too. I am feeling in best of health. I am sure It was very I guess it is for the best. Will be saying good night now. We get plenty of sleep here Love Jack
